services.name: After School Programs
services.desc: Get into the act! With plenty of parts to go around, including featured roles as well as ensemble parts these productions are sure to get you into the act and having tons of fun. Make new friends. Strengthen your confidence and musical theatre presence. Learn to project your voice, take your dance moves to the next level, and interpret these fantastic musicals as only you can. For grades 2-6. Pick-up: MacGuffin teachers will pick up actors at Greenfield Elementary School at 3 PM and walk them 2 blocks to our theatre at the Adrienne (2030 Sansom Street, 2nd Floor). Parents can pick up their young actor at 5:30 PM at MacGuffin. They will meet you in the Adrienne Lobby. Session 1 - KPop Scenes
